ANGELA.name: Spear of Ichors
ANGELA.desc: Lunge forward with your spear, dealing damage that increases with Attack Charge. At full charge, Spear of Ichor can launch up enemies

ANGELA.name: Axes Of Ichors
ANGELA.desc: Alternate powerful strikes forward with twin axes, dealing increased damage as Attack Charge grows. The fourth strike propels you forward in a swift dash

ANGELA.name: SHIELDED STANCE
ANGELA.desc: Transform Ichors into a shield, gaining Attack Charge when absorbing damage

ANGELA.name: Heven's Retribution
ANGELA.desc: Wrap your spear in ribbons and hurl it with force. Upon impact, the ribbons bind nearby enemies. Angela can leap to the spear's location, damaging surrounding enemies and creating a Divine Judgement Zone

ANGELA.name: Assassin's Charge
ANGELA.desc: Enter an accelerated dash state,  enemies struck head-on are carried through the air for a short distance

ANGELA.name: Divine Judgement
ANGELA.desc: Dive downward, switch to twin axes and infuse the ground with Ichors to create a Divine Judgement Zone upon impact. Within the zone, gain enhanced Speed and attacks grant Bonus Health to self and nearby allies

ANGELA.name: Wingblade Ascent
ANGELA.desc: Take to the skies, switching back to Spear of Ichors

ANGELA.name: Seraphic Soar
ANGELA.desc: Glide freely through the air. Continuous flight builds Attack Charge

ANGELA.name: Celestial Command
ANGELA.desc: Angela shares fragments of her Ichors with Thor, empowering him to hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor can leap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range

CAPTAIN AMERICA.name: Sentinel Strike
CAPTAIN AMERICA.desc: Get up close to strike enemies. Landing the second hit enables a shield throw that can ricochet four times

CAPTAIN AMERICA.name: Super-Soldier Slam
CAPTAIN AMERICA.desc: Slam down from the sky onto the targeted area, Launching Up enemies

CAPTAIN AMERICA.name: Living Legend
CAPTAIN AMERICA.desc: Raise the shield to deflect incoming projectiles, sending them ricocheting in random directions

CAPTAIN AMERICA.name: Freedom Charge
CAPTAIN AMERICA.desc: Shield held high, carve a path forward, granting both himself and allies along the path continuous Bonus Health and Movement Boosts. Allies also gain Ultimate Ability Charge Acceleration. Using Living Legend and Leading Dash while this ability is active can Launch Up enemies

CAPTAIN AMERICA.name: Leading Dash
CAPTAIN AMERICA.desc: Boost speed and enable Fearless Leap to leap into the air

CAPTAIN AMERICA.name: Vibranium Energy Saw
CAPTAIN AMERICA.desc: Hurl the energy-charged shield to strike enemies in a path

CAPTAIN AMERICA.name: Liberty Rush
CAPTAIN AMERICA.desc: Raise the shield and charge forward

CAPTAIN AMERICA.name: VIBRANIUM BASTION
CAPTAIN AMERICA.desc: Black Cat shares her luck with her allies. When White Fox embraces her newfound fortune, she unleashestracking Spirit Tails to grant Healing and Speed to allies, while damaging and Slowing foes. When Captain America enjoys his luck, his shield's block radius expands and allows him to aim deflectedProjectiles directly toward his target

CAPTAIN AMERICA.name: Captain's Spirit
CAPTAIN AMERICA.desc: Inspired by Captain America's resolve, Winter Soldier can leap to the aid of a designated ally, slamming the ground with his mechanical arm to deal damage to nearby foes. Additionally, Captain America and Winter Soldier can interact with each other once both parties confirm. The duo collides and unleashes a shockwave that deals damage and inflicts slow on enemies

DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - VANGUARD
DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).desc: Nobody lays a finger on my teammates! Anyone tries, and I'm firing these big boy bullets straight at their face!

upgrade.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - VANGUARD UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: I rack up shots, then, BOOM! A mind-blowing bubble bomb for all the enemies. Teammate security: maximum

DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).name: KICK@$$ KATANA - VANGUARD
DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).desc: Protecting my team means my katanas go full savage. No mercy for the baddies!

upgrade.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - VANGUARD UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Relax, you've got Deadpool on your side! Swords out, baddies out. My stab hits crit, and a Bad Bunny hit makes the next swing a stabby special

DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).name: MAGICAL UNICORN SHIELD!
DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).desc: Plushie power! It stops every single attack those chumps throw, giving my team a safety bubble. It's cute AND bulletproof

upgrade.name: MAGICAL UNICORN SHIELD! - UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: My ultra-cool, super shiny, extra huggable, and totally blinged-out plushy. Toss it ahead, and it lands as an invincible sphere of awesomeness! Blocking attacks and keeping my team safe inside our furry fortress

DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).name: HAZARDOUS HIJINKS - VANGUARD
DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).desc: Try getting to my teammates, I dare you! My dash slash knocks fools down, and if I hit, I get to do it again. Up to three times, baby!

upgrade.name: HAZARDOUS HIJINKS - VANGUARD UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Watch this pro bodyguard in action! I dash forward, nail the bad guy, and bounce in any direction I want. Oh, and I can do this two more times real quick!

DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).name: THE BAN HAMMER
DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).desc: You! Yeah, you - the hyper one! Eyes off my friends. I sentence you to...whatever! Get ready to be taunted. I get bonus HP and healing, and if you whiff your abilities, you take damage, and I get even more HP!

upgrade.name: THE BAN HAMMER - UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Upgraded courtroom drama! Congrats, unlucky one! You're my pick; enjoy the taunt! I score bonus health and healing, and you take ongoing damage. If you miss an ability while court is in session, it's a double whammy. You get more pain, AND I get more extra HP! Thanks in advance!

DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).name: THE BIG TEST
DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).desc: Wake the #!&% up, hero! We've got a game to win! Speed and healing buffs for starters, bonus Hazardous Hijinks for me, and extra HP for me and my nearby friends. Hit enough baddies with the right abilities exactly as I ask, and you unlock mega speed and healing, plus reset my Healing Factor cooldown!. Team protection mode: activated!

upgrade.name: THE BIG TEST - UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Hey, player! Warm-up's over, time for the main event! Speed, healing, dashes, for me, and bonus HP for all! Smash enough baddies with the skills I say, and you unlock super buffs (massive speed and healing), plus Healing Factor resets. For some time after, each hit means more HP for the crew and you. Don't mess this up!

DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - VANGUARD
DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).desc: Want to hurt my team? Good luck! I hit you with a taunt, mess up your vision, and burn your health nonstop! Best part: my swords and guns go full turbo for the duration. Blink and you'll miss it

upgrade.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - VANGUARD UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Teammates, stay safe! Dummies, look here! It's showtime: I taunt, blind you, and hit warp speed with my swords and guns. Plus, my crew gets a damage reduction buff, so they're basically invincible. Dummies that stick around too long will even have their UI taped over!

DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).name: UPGRADE!
DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).desc: I'm here to smack baddies, get XP, and shield my friends! When my XP is full, I get to upgrade an ability! Bonus: Score the final hit and force your foe into a selfie—more XP for me! I'm invincible while striking my best duckface. No photobombs!

DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).name: BUNNY BOUNCE
DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).desc: Yup, I can double jump in midair! During The Big Test and its upgrade, I can also stomp heads and wall jump to reset its cooldown. Stomp enemies so hard they won't get near my team!

DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).name: HEALING FACTOR
DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).desc: Out of combat? I'm healing up, staying battle-ready to protect my team. And if I'm about to croak? Surprise! I get a free pass, and my health zooms back up. Nice try, villains

DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).name: MAXIMUM FLAIR
DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).desc: Listen up, eyes on the prize, don't wander off! Every time my abilities land on a bad guy, the style points shoot up a notch! When it's full, I can pop my ultimate! With me on the team, you're all staying alive and fabulous!

DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).name: Comical Chaos
DEADPOOL (VANGUARD).desc: Deadpool hands Jeff the Land Shark a plushie with attitude. Jeff can spit it ahead where it'll continuously Taunt nearby enemies and Block Vision, while allies in range enjoy a plush-powered healing party!

DEVIL DINOSAUR.name: Primal Bite
DEVIL DINOSAUR.desc: Bite forward. Applies a Bleed that deals continuous Percentage Damage

DEVIL DINOSAUR.name: Impact Beam
DEVIL DINOSAUR.desc: Unleash a devastating beam of energy that inflicts a Bleed and Slow.

DEVIL DINOSAUR.name: Devil-Beast Rampage
DEVIL DINOSAUR.desc: Erupt in primal fury! Gain a massive Movement Speed Boost while unleashing earth-shattering stomps that Launch enemies and applies a Bleed. Thunderous roars also emit sonic waves that Slow enemies hit

DEVIL DINOSAUR.name: Savage Predation
DEVIL DINOSAUR.desc: Dash and pounce on your prey with a vicious bite, applying a Bleed. If the target is already Bleeding, clamp down before hurling them away

DEVIL DINOSAUR.name: Buddy Barrier
DEVIL DINOSAUR.desc: Activate the heart-shaped generator to expand a spherical shield that blocks incoming damage. Enemies caught within are Slowed

DEVIL DINOSAUR.name: Frenzied Feast
DEVIL DINOSAUR.desc: Unleash a flurry of continuous bites, converting the damage dealt into Bonus Health. Deals extra damage against Bleeding targets

DEVIL DINOSAUR.name: Prehistoric Plating
DEVIL DINOSAUR.desc: Take reduced damage from headshots. Immune to launch-up, knock-back, and other displacement effects. Enemies and allies generate less Ultimate Ability Energy when damaging or healing him

DEVIL DINOSAUR.name: Apex Advantage
DEVIL DINOSAUR.desc: Gain Bonus Health when you inflict Bleeding upon an enemy

DEVIL DINOSAUR.name: Prehistoric Partner
DEVIL DINOSAUR.desc: The Punisher rides atop Devil Dinosaur, restricting him to only Adjudication/Deliverance and Scourge Grenade while disabling other abilities. While mounted, Devil Dinosaur absorbs a portion of all damage inflicted on The Punisher

DOCTOR STRANGE.name: Shield of the Seraphim
DOCTOR STRANGE.desc: Create a protective barrier against damage

DOCTOR STRANGE.name: Eye of Agamotto
DOCTOR STRANGE.desc: Separate nearby enemies' Souls from their bodies. Damage dealt to these Souls is transferred to their physical bodies

DOCTOR STRANGE.name: Cloak of Levitation
DOCTOR STRANGE.desc: Ascend and then enter a brief state of sustained flight

DOCTOR STRANGE.name: Maelstrom of Madness
DOCTOR STRANGE.desc: Release Dark Magic to deal damage to nearby enemies

DOCTOR STRANGE.name: PSIONIC VORTEX
DOCTOR STRANGE.desc: Invisible Woman enhances Doctor Strange's Maelstrom of Madness with a psionic explosion. The explosion damages and pulls enemies toward Doctor Strange. Based on the explosion's damage, Doctor Strange and nearby allies gain Bonus Health

DOCTOR STRANGE.name: Pentagram of Farallah
DOCTOR STRANGE.desc: Open portals between two locations, enabling all units to travel through them

DOCTOR STRANGE.name: Price of Magic
DOCTOR STRANGE.desc: Dark Magic accumulates with every hit on an enemy. If Dark Magic peaks for too long, Doctor Strange will be cursed with Anti-Heal

DOCTOR STRANGE.name: Enchanted Enhancement
DOCTOR STRANGE.desc: Doctor Strange shares his arcane mastery, replacing Scarlet Witch's Chthonian Burst with Mystic Burst upon activation. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction

Emma Frost.name: TELEPATHIC PULSE
Emma Frost.desc: Fire a psionic beam to deal damage; the longer the beam hits, the higher the damage

Emma Frost.name: FACETED FURY
Emma Frost.desc: In Diamond Form, deliver a crushing double-fisted strike to enemies

Emma Frost.name: MIND'S AEGIS
Emma Frost.desc: Create a levitating barrier at the designated location

Emma Frost.name: CRYSTAL KICK
Emma Frost.desc: In Diamond Form, unleash a flying kick forward and knock back enemies; extra damage is dealt if they're propelled into a wall

Emma Frost.name: PSIONIC SEDUCTION
Emma Frost.desc: Project a forward psychic assault that stuns foes and prevents them from unleashing their Ultimate Abilities; if the effect lingers, it gradually commandeers their mind, forcing them to move toward Emma Frost

Emma Frost.name: DIAMOND FORM
Emma Frost.desc: Activate Diamond Form to transform your attack style while gaining Damage Reduction and becoming Unstoppable

Emma Frost.name: PSYCHIC SPEAR
Emma Frost.desc: Seize control of an enemy's sentience—damage dealt to the sentience cascades to the physical form and can be pierced by Telepathic Pulse. When the sentience shatters, it unleashes extra damage on its owner

Emma Frost.name: CARBON CRUSH
Emma Frost.desc: In Diamond Form, lunge forward to grab an enemy, then execute a back slam to inflict damage

Emma Frost.name: ICED OUT DIAMOND
Emma Frost.desc: Luna Snow grants Winter's Chill to Iron Fist and Emma Frost. When Iron Fist activates Harmony Recovery, he can heal nearby allies with Lunar Chi. Emma Frost can project ice energy forward, dealing damage and slowing enemies. She can also enhance her diamond form, condensing frost into an Absolute Zero Diamond barrier that blocks enemy attacks and movement

GROOT.name: Spore Bomb
GROOT.desc: Throw an explosive Spore Bomb that splits into multiple small explosive spores

GROOT.name: Strangling Prison
GROOT.desc: Fire a massive vine cluster that pulls nearby enemies to its center and Imprisons them

GROOT.name: Thornlash Wall
GROOT.desc: Target a location and grow a Thornlash Wall. When Awakened, it strikes nearby enemies attacked by Groot and his allies

GROOT.name: Ironwood Wall
GROOT.desc: Target a location and grow an Ironwood Wall. When the wall is Awakened, damage dealt by Groot and nearby allies grants Groot Bonus Health. Groot gains Unstoppable while near Ironwood Walls

GROOT.name: Wild Wall
GROOT.desc: Mantis enhances Groot's wooden walls and Loki's Rune Stones with life energy. Groot can additionally unleash a Flower Wall, which, when in Flora Colossus state, restores health to random nearby allies and grants them Damage Reduction. Loki's Rune Stones grant allies within Regeneration Domain a Damage Boost

GROOT.name: Furious Flora
GROOT.desc: Perform a combo with his arms, and the third strike will slightly Launch Up the hit enemy airborne

GROOT.name: Flora Colossus
GROOT.desc: Wooden walls near Groot will Awaken, activating an extra effect. Right-click while building a wooden wall to continue building additional walls

HULK.name: Gamma Ray Gun
HULK.desc: Fire with a Gamma Ray Gun

HULK.name: Heavy Blow
HULK.desc: Swing fists forward to punch enemies

HULK.name: Heavy Blow
HULK.desc: Swing fists forward to punch and launch up enemies

HULK.name: Gamma Burst
HULK.desc: Emit gamma-ray bursts to inflict damage. Reduce Indestructible Guard cooldown upon hit

HULK.name: Gamma Burst
HULK.desc: Emit gamma-ray bursts to inflict damage

HULK.name: Puny Banner
HULK.desc: Transform from Bruce Banner into Hero Hulk

HULK.name: HULK SMASH!
HULK.desc: Unleash stored gamma energy, transforming from Hero Hulk into Monster Hulk for a limited time period

HULK.name: World Breaker
HULK.desc: Grab and smash the enemy in front

HULK.name: Gamma Grenade
HULK.desc: Launch a Gamma Grenade to inflict damage and Launch Up enemies

HULK.name: Indestructible Guard
HULK.desc: Generate gamma shields for Hero Hulk and nearby allies, absorbing and converting damage into energy for HULK SMASH

HULK.name: Radioactive Lockdown
HULK.desc: Emit gamma energy to irradiate enemies and render them immobilize and immune to all ability effects. Using Heavy Blow or Gamma Burst will prematurely remove this status

HULK.name: Radioactive Lockdown
HULK.desc: Emit gamma energy to irradiate enemies and render them immobilize and immune to all ability effects. Using Heavy Blow or Gamma Burst will prematurely remove this status

HULK.name: Gamma Fastball
HULK.desc: Wolverine, Hulk can interact with each other. Once both parties confirm, Hulk can lift Wolverine and press the key to hurl him forward

HULK.name: Gamma Fastball
HULK.desc: Wolverine, Hulk can interact with each other. Once both parties confirm, Hulk can lift Wolverine and press the key to hurl him forward

HULK.name: Incredible Leap
HULK.desc: HOLD Space to perform a charged leap that allows Hero Hulk to Knock a flying enemy to the ground

HULK.name: Incredible Leap
HULK.desc: HOLD Space to perform a charged leap that allows Monster Hulk to Knock a flying enemy to the ground

HULK.name: Gamma Boost
HULK.desc: Hulk charges Iron Man and Namor with gamma radiation. When Iron Man uses Armor Overdrive, he will initiate a gamma upgrade. When Namor receives the radiation, he will summon an extra Gamma Monstro which will continuously fire gamma rays at locked-on enemies. The longer the rays hit, the higher the damage

HULK.name: Gamma Boost
HULK.desc: Hulk charges Iron Man and Namor with gamma radiation. When Iron Man uses Armor Overdrive, he will initiate a gamma upgrade. When Namor receives the radiation, he will summon an extra Gamma Monstro which will continuously fire gamma rays at locked-on enemies. The longer the rays hit, the higher the damage

HULK.name: Gamma Boost
HULK.desc: Hulk charges Iron Man and Namor with gamma radiation. When Iron Man uses Armor Overdrive, he will initiate a gamma upgrade. When Namor receives the radiation, he will summon an extra Gamma Monstro which will continuously fire gamma rays at locked-on enemies. The longer the rays hit, the higher the damage

MAGNETO.name: Iron Volley
MAGNETO.desc: Fire a volley of magnetic orbs forward. The range of the resulting explosion increases based on distance flown

MAGNETO.name: Mag-Cannon
MAGNETO.desc: Convert the iron rings on Magneto's back into a Mag-Cannon and launch a metallic mass forward. Higher stacks of rings increase damage, and full stacks knock back enemies

MAGNETO.name: Meteor M
MAGNETO.desc: Draw in all materials around to forge an iron meteor that deals massive damage upon impact. Absorbing enemy projectiles can enhance the meteor's power, yet overloading will cause it to self-destruct

MAGNETO.name: Metallic Curtain
MAGNETO.desc: Change the magnetic field around to form a metallic curtain, blocking all incoming projectiles

MAGNETO.name: Metal Bulwark
MAGNETO.desc: Conjure a metal shield around a chosen ally. Damage taken will transform into rings on Magneto's back

MAGNETO.name: Iron Bulwark
MAGNETO.desc: Conjure an iron shield around himself. Damage taken will transform into rings on Magneto's back

MAGNETO.name: ROYAL BLADE
MAGNETO.desc: Gambit charges Magneto's greatsword with kinetic energy. When Magneto activates this ability, Iron Volley is replaced with Ace Greatsword, which detonates upon striking enemies. The explosion leaves residual kinetic energy within the target, inflicting secondary damage after a brief delay

PENI PARKER.name: Cyber-Web Snare
PENI PARKER.desc: Cast futuristic webbing that Immobilizes enemies or creates a Cyber-Web. While in the Cyber-Web, Peni and allies gain Healing Over Time and a Movement Boost. Excess healing converts into Bonus Health

PENI PARKER.name: Spider-Sweeper
PENI PARKER.desc: Enhance the SP//dr suit, launching up enemies in its path and deploying Arachno-Mines, Spider-Drones, and Cyber-Webs repeatedly

PENI PARKER.name: Bionic Spider-Nest
PENI PARKER.desc: Generate a Bionic Spider-Nest at a targeted area, periodically spawning Spider-Drones and creating Cyber-Webs. While in the Cyber-Web, Peni and allies gain Healing Over Time and a Movement Boost. Excess healing converts into Bonus Health. Spider-Drones inflict a Slow effect on hit, which can stack and refresh its effect period with multiple hits

PENI PARKER.name: Arachno-Mine
PENI PARKER.desc: Deploy Arachno-Mines that can be concealed within the confines of a Cyber-Web

PENI PARKER.name: Cyber-Bond
PENI PARKER.desc: Shoot a web strand that links to the targeted area or Cyber-Web. If stretched too far, it will trigger a pullback

PENI PARKER.name: ARMORIZED SPIDER-NEST
PENI PARKER.desc: Enhanced by Rocket Raccoon, Peni Parker’s Bionic Spider-Nest regularly generates strengthened armor packs. Each armor pack grants bonus health to the hero who picks up the pack. Peni Parker can deploy Bionic Spider-Nest and Armored Spider-Nest at the same time

PENI PARKER.name: Wall Crawl
PENI PARKER.desc: HOLD Jump to crawl on vertical surfaces

PENI PARKER.name: Cyber-Spiders
PENI PARKER.desc: Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging a Web-Cluster shot and granting Bonus Health

Rogue.name: Southern Brawl
Rogue.desc: While in Defensive Stance, dash forward and slam enemies in front, dealing area damage

Rogue.name: Defensive Stance
Rogue.desc: Absorb nearby projectiles and reduce incoming damage; absorbed damage powers up your next Southern Brawl

Rogue.name: Heartbreaker
Rogue.desc: Continuously absorb Ultimate Ability Energy from nearby enemies and steal stats based on their role

Rogue.name: Fatal Attraction
Rogue.desc: Dash forward. Press again to unleash a burst of Chronovium Power, dealing continuous damage to nearby foes; after a delay, the energy retracts, pulling all enemies towards Rogue

Rogue.name: Chrono Kick Combo
Rogue.desc: Dash forward and launch the enemy, entering flight; activate again to Knock Down nearby enemies. Your next two Power Surge Punch attacks become ranged, piercing enemies and granting Bonus Health

Rogue.name: Ability Absorption
Rogue.desc: Dash forward to knock down your target and absorb their energy; after absorbing, replace Ability Absorption with one of their abilities or refresh Fatal Attraction. Also absorb Health and stats based on their role

Rogue.name: HEARTS AS ONE
Rogue.desc: Gambit shares kinetic energy with Magneto and Rogue. When Magneto activates this ability, Iron Volley is replaced with Ace Greatsword, which detonates upon striking enemies. The explosion leaves residual kinetic energy within the target, inflicting secondary damage after a brief delay. When Rogue activates the ability, each of her attacks causes a kinetic explosion that damages nearby enemies and heals nearby allies

THE THING.name: Stone Haymaker
THE THING.desc: Deliver a devastating Heavy Blow. Can Knock Down flying enemies.

THE THING.name: Clobberin' Time
THE THING.desc: Use immense power to launch up all enemies in front of the Thing into the air

THE THING.name: Yancy Street Charge
THE THING.desc: Continuously charge forward, launching up enemies and leaving behind a zone at the final position that prevents the use of mobility abilities

THE THING.name: Embattled Leap
THE THING.desc: Jump toward an ally and apply damage reduction to yourself and allies within the landing area

THE THING.name: Battle Blitz
THE THING.desc: Jump toward an enemy and apply Vulnerability to enemies within the landing area

THE THING.name: GAMMA CHARGE
THE THING.desc: Hulk charges Black Panther and The Thing with gamma radiation. When Black Panther's health is low, he gains a gamma shield, becoming Unstoppable and blocking attacks. The Thing gains Gamma Gauntlets, boosting Damage and range of his Rocky Jab and Stone Haymaker. Dealing damage with these attacks grants Bonus Health, and maximum Bonus Health cap is increased

THE THING.name: Flying Thing
THE THING.desc: Human Torch can lift The Thing into the air and slam him down, dealing damage, launching enemies, and creating a zone that disables mobility abilities

THE THING.name: Cosmic Fastball
THE THING.desc: Wolverine and The Thing can interact with each other. Once both parties confirm, The Thing can lift Wolverine and press the key to hurl him forward

THE THING.name: Unyielding Will
THE THING.desc: Immune to launch-up, knock-back, and other displacement effects

THOR.name: Mjolnir Bash
THOR.desc: Wield Mjolnir to strike enemies. When Awakened, Thor can launch lightning arc waves to deal damage

THOR.name: Hammer Throw
THOR.desc: Throw Mjolnir forward which then returns

THOR.name: God of Thunder
THOR.desc: Soar upwards and smite the ground after charging for a duration, inflicting damage on enemies within range

THOR.name: Storm Surge
THOR.desc: Hold to spin Mjolnir before dashing forward and knocking back enemies

THOR.name: Lightning Realm
THOR.desc: Summon lightning that restores Thorforce based on the number of hit enemies

THOR.name: Awakening Rune
THOR.desc: Consume Thorforce to enter the Awakened state, granting Bonus Health and enhancing Mjolnir Bash

THOR.name: THUNDERSTRIKE PIKE
THOR.desc: Angela shares fragments of her Ichors with Thor, empowering him to hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor can leap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range

THOR.name: Thorforce
THOR.desc: Consume Thorforce to gain Bonus Health. Landing Mjolnir Bash on an enemy instantly recharges Thorforce

The Hood.name: Accursed Pistols
The Hood.desc: Shoot forward dual-wielded pistols. Gain increased Attack Speed when Demonic Energy exceeds 50%

The Hood.name: Leaded Transformation
The Hood.desc: Enter Half-Demon State, transforming your arms into demonic rifles to unleash a rain of lead. These rifles have increased Attack Speed and Infinite Ammo. Every bullet that strikes an enemy triggers Lifesteal

The Hood.name: Mantle of Oblivion
The Hood.desc: Spread your cloak to form a spherical barrier, blocking incoming enemy attacks. When Demonic Energy exceeds 50%, the radius of the sphere expands further.

The Hood.name: Demon of the End
The Hood.desc: Enter Full Demon State. Fire up to 6 high-powered shots that pierce through enemies and barriers, with the final shot being the most powerful. Hitting enemies grants Bonus Health to yourself and nearby allies

The Hood.name: Void Walk
The Hood.desc: Enter the Void for free-flight. Upon reappearing, gain a decaying Movement Boost and damage surrounding enemies

The Hood.name: Abyssal Veil
The Hood.desc: Throw a dark magic sphere that generates a Veil upon landing. Accursed Pistols shots passing through it generate more Demonic Energy and bullets from Leaded Transformation gain increased Lifesteal. Enemy projectiles passing through suffer reduced damage and healing output. Enemies who pass through the Veil take damage and are Blinded

The Hood.name: Ruinous Pact
The Hood.desc: Accumulate Demonic Energy by dealing damage via Accursed Pistols, blocking attacks with Mantle of Oblivion, or by using Void Walk. Reaching full energy automatically triggers the Half-Demon State

VENOM.name: Dark Predation
VENOM.desc: Unleash tentacles forward to attack enemies

VENOM.name: Cellular Corrosion
VENOM.desc: Unleash tentacles to Slow enemies within reach. Enemies unable to break free in time will suffer damage

VENOM.name: Feast of the Abyss
VENOM.desc: Burrow underground for free movement. After a duration or by left-clicking, devour enemies above to deal damage based on the enemy's current health and generate equivalent Bonus Health. Devoured enemies suffer Reduced Healing

VENOM.name: Venom Swing
VENOM.desc: Launch webbing forward, allowing for a singular swing in the desired direction

VENOM.name: Symbiotic Resilience
VENOM.desc: Generate Bonus Health against damage. The lower Venom's Health, the greater the Bonus Health generated

VENOM.name: Frenzied Arrival
VENOM.desc: Dash to the target location from a certain height. Upon landing, damage nearby enemies, launching them up toward the landing point

VENOM.name: Alien Biology
VENOM.desc: Press Space to wall crawl, and while crawling, left-click to sprint

VENOM.name: HEALING TENDRILS
VENOM.desc: Venom shares his symbiotes with Jeff and Hela. Jeff's Guardian of the Deep links with nearby allies, providing continuous healing. When the effect ends, it releases a powerful healing burst, converting any excess into Bonus Health. Hela's Hel Tendrils unleash a symbiotic Hel Sphere. Upon hit, it pulls nearby enemies toward the impact point and links them, slowing enemies that try to escape.
